meanings.en: the firing of a gun or the sound it makes
meanings.exampleEn: We heard a gunshot in the distance and ran for cover.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzakta bir silah sesi duyduk ve siper aldık.

meanings.en: courage and determination
meanings.exampleEn: It takes guts to speak the truth in front of your boss.
meanings.exampleTr: Patronunun önünde gerçeği söylemek cesaret ister.

meanings.en: relating to gymnastics or physical exercises
meanings.exampleEn: She performed an impressive gymnastic routine on the beam.
meanings.exampleTr: Denge aletinde etkileyici bir jimnastik gösterisi yaptı.

meanings.en: an inhabitant or resident of a place
meanings.exampleEn: Every habitant of the village gathered in the square for the festival.
meanings.exampleTr: Köyün her sakini şenlik için meydanda toplandı.

meanings.en: to call out to or signal someone, especially to stop a vehicle
meanings.exampleEn: She stepped onto the street to hail a taxi.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir taksi çağırmak için caddeye çıktı.

meanings.en: covered with a lot of hair
meanings.exampleEn: He had thick, hairy arms from years of outdoor work.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllarca açık havada çalışmaktan kalın, kıllı kolları vardı.

meanings.en: a condition or circumstance that makes progress difficult
meanings.exampleEn: His lack of experience was a serious handicap in the negotiations.
meanings.exampleTr: Deneyim eksikliği müzakerelerde ciddi bir engeldi.

meanings.en: a skill or product made by hand
meanings.exampleEn: The market sells traditional handicraft made by local artisans.
meanings.exampleTr: Pazarda yerel zanaatkârların yaptığı geleneksel el işleri satılıyor.

meanings.en: a printed sheet given to people, or free money or goods given to those in need
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher gave each student a handout summarizing the lesson.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen her öğrenciye dersi özetleyen bir bilgi notu verdi.

meanings.en: a rail fixed beside stairs or a path for people to hold
meanings.exampleEn: Hold the handrail tightly as you climb the steep stairs.
meanings.exampleTr: Dik merdivenleri çıkarken tırabzana sıkıca tutun.

meanings.en: the way something works or is done (as in 'get the hang of')
meanings.exampleEn: After a few tries, she finally got the hang of riding a bicycle.
meanings.exampleTr: Birkaç denemeden sonra sonunda bisiklet sürmenin püf noktasını kaptı.

meanings.en: the part of a computer that stores data permanently
meanings.exampleEn: I saved all my photos onto an external hard drive.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün fotoğraflarımı harici bir sabit diske kaydettim.

meanings.en: the physical parts of a computer, or tools and equipment
meanings.exampleEn: The new software requires more powerful hardware to run smoothly.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni yazılımın sorunsuz çalışması için daha güçlü donanım gerekiyor.

meanings.en: physical or other injury or damage
meanings.exampleEn: Smoking can cause serious harm to your health.
meanings.exampleTr: Sigara içmek sağlığınıza ciddi zarar verebilir.

meanings.en: not able or likely to cause harm
meanings.exampleEn: The snake looks dangerous but is actually completely harmless.
meanings.exampleTr: Yılan tehlikeli görünüyor ama aslında tamamen zararsız.

meanings.en: a farming tool used to break up and level soil
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer pulled a harrow across the field to prepare it for planting.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi, tarlayı ekime hazırlamak için üzerinden bir tırmık çekti.

meanings.en: excessive speed or urgency in doing something
meanings.exampleEn: In his haste to leave, he forgot his keys on the table.
meanings.exampleTr: Çıkmak için acele ederken anahtarlarını masada unuttu.

meanings.en: in a quick and hurried manner
meanings.exampleEn: She hastily packed her bag and rushed out the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Çantasını aceleyle topladı ve kapıdan dışarı fırladı.

meanings.en: the process of a young animal emerging from an egg
meanings.exampleEn: We watched the hatching of the baby turtles on the beach.
meanings.exampleTr: Sahilde yavru kaplumbağaların yumurtadan çıkışını izledik.

meanings.en: poignant and beautiful in a way that lingers in the mind
meanings.exampleEn: The film's haunting melody stayed with me for days.
meanings.exampleTr: Filmin akıldan çıkmayan melodisi günlerce aklımda kaldı.

meanings.en: grass that has been cut and dried for animal feed
meanings.exampleEn: The farmer stored bales of hay in the barn for winter.
meanings.exampleTr: Çiftçi kış için ambara balya balya kuru ot depoladı.

meanings.en: dangerous or risky, especially to health or safety
meanings.exampleEn: Workers must wear masks when handling hazardous chemicals.
meanings.exampleTr: İşçiler tehlikeli kimyasallarla çalışırken maske takmalıdır.

meanings.en: the services provided to maintain or restore people's health
meanings.exampleEn: The government promised to improve health care for everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Hükümet herkes için sağlık hizmetini iyileştirmeye söz verdi.

meanings.en: an untidy pile of things
meanings.exampleEn: He left his dirty clothes in a heap on the floor.
meanings.exampleTr: Kirli kıyafetlerini yerde bir yığın halinde bıraktı.

meanings.en: causing great sadness or distress
meanings.exampleEn: It was heartbreaking to see the abandoned dog shivering in the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Terk edilmiş köpeğin yağmurda titremesini görmek yürek parçalayıcıydı.

meanings.en: causing feelings of happiness and affection
meanings.exampleEn: The film told a heartwarming story of friendship and hope.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, dostluk ve umut hakkında yürek ısıtan bir hikâye anlattı.

meanings.en: an aircraft that flies using rotating blades
meanings.exampleEn: A rescue helicopter lifted the injured climbers off the mountain.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir kurtarma helikopteri yaralı dağcıları dağdan kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a place of suffering or great difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: The long, painful journey through the desert was sheer hell.
meanings.exampleTr: Çölde geçen uzun, acılı yolculuk tam bir cehennemdi.

meanings.en: a person who helps another with a task
meanings.exampleEn: The chef relied on two helpers to prepare the meals.
meanings.exampleTr: Şef yemekleri hazırlamak için iki yardımcıya güveniyordu.

meanings.en: a plant used to make rope, fabric, and other products
meanings.exampleEn: These strong ropes are made from natural hemp fibers.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu sağlam ipler doğal kenevir liflerinden yapılmıştır.

meanings.en: a plant used for flavoring, medicine, or scent
meanings.exampleEn: She added a fresh herb to the soup to improve the flavor.
meanings.exampleTr: Tadını güzelleştirmek için çorbaya taze bir ot ekledi.

meanings.en: the traditions, buildings, and culture inherited from the past
meanings.exampleEn: The ancient castle is an important part of the nation's heritage.
meanings.exampleTr: Antik kale, ulusun kültürel mirasının önemli bir parçasıdır.

meanings.en: a pause or delay caused by uncertainty
meanings.exampleEn: After a moment's hesitation, she agreed to take the job.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir anlık tereddütten sonra işi kabul etmeyi onayladı.

meanings.en: using or involving advanced technology
meanings.exampleEn: The factory uses high-tech machines to assemble the cars.
meanings.exampleTr: Fabrika, arabaları monte etmek için ileri teknolojili makineler kullanıyor.

meanings.en: the act of illegally seizing control of a vehicle or aircraft
meanings.exampleEn: The plane hijack ended peacefully after long negotiations.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçak kaçırma olayı uzun müzakerelerin ardından barışçıl şekilde sona erdi.

meanings.en: extremely funny
meanings.exampleEn: His jokes were so hilarious that everyone burst out laughing.
meanings.exampleTr: Şakaları o kadar komikti ki herkes kahkahayı bastı.

meanings.en: a slight or indirect indication or suggestion
meanings.exampleEn: Can you give me a hint about the answer to the puzzle?
meanings.exampleTr: Bulmacanın cevabı hakkında bana bir ipucu verebilir misin?

meanings.en: a person who holds something, or a device that holds an object
meanings.exampleEn: The passport holder must sign on the first page.
meanings.exampleTr: Pasaport sahibi ilk sayfayı imzalamalıdır.

meanings.en: having an empty space inside
meanings.exampleEn: The squirrel hid its nuts inside a hollow tree.
meanings.exampleTr: Sincap fındıklarını içi boş bir ağacın içine sakladı.

meanings.en: destruction or slaughter on a massive scale
meanings.exampleEn: The museum documents the horrors of the wartime holocaust.
meanings.exampleTr: Müze, savaş zamanı soykırımının dehşetini belgeliyor.

meanings.en: going toward home
meanings.exampleEn: After the long trip, they began their homeward journey at dawn.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yolculuktan sonra, şafakta eve dönüş yolculuklarına başladılar.

meanings.en: a fine-grained stone used for sharpening blades
meanings.exampleEn: The carpenter sharpened his chisel on a smooth hone.
meanings.exampleTr: Marangoz kalemini düzgün bir bileği taşında biledi.

meanings.en: deserving respect; having high moral principles
meanings.exampleEn: He made an honorable decision to return the lost wallet.
meanings.exampleTr: Kayıp cüzdanı geri vermek gibi onurlu bir karar verdi.

meanings.en: a covering for the head, or the cover over a car engine
meanings.exampleEn: She pulled up her hood to protect herself from the rain.
meanings.exampleTr: Kendini yağmurdan korumak için kapüşonunu kaldırdı.

meanings.en: a curved piece of metal or plastic used for hanging or catching things
meanings.exampleEn: He hung his coat on a hook behind the door.
meanings.exampleTr: Paltosunu kapının arkasındaki bir kancaya astı.

meanings.en: a place that cares for terminally ill people
meanings.exampleEn: The hospice provided comfort and care to patients in their final days.
meanings.exampleTr: Bakımevi, hastalara son günlerinde rahatlık ve bakım sağladı.

meanings.en: friendly and welcoming to guests or strangers
meanings.exampleEn: The villagers were so hospitable that they invited us to dinner.
meanings.exampleTr: Köylüler o kadar misafirperverdi ki bizi akşam yemeğine davet ettiler.

meanings.en: to admit someone to a hospital for treatment
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors had to hospitalize him after the serious accident.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar ciddi kazadan sonra onu hastaneye yatırmak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: happening or done every hour
meanings.exampleEn: The hourly bus service makes it easy to travel into the city.
meanings.exampleTr: Saat başı kalkan otobüs seferi şehre gitmeyi kolaylaştırıyor.

meanings.en: a person employed to manage and clean a house
meanings.exampleEn: The hotel's housekeeper cleaned each room every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Otelin ev hizmetlisi her sabah her odayı temizledi.

meanings.en: a male teacher in charge of a boarding house at a school
meanings.exampleEn: The housemaster made sure all the students were in bed by ten.
meanings.exampleTr: Yurt müdürü tüm öğrencilerin saat onda yatakta olmasını sağladı.

meanings.en: a married woman who manages her home and does not work outside
meanings.exampleEn: As a housewife, she spent most of her day caring for the children.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir ev hanımı olarak gününün çoğunu çocuklara bakarak geçirdi.

meanings.en: to remain in one place in the air
meanings.exampleEn: The hummingbird seemed to hover above the flower.
meanings.exampleTr: Sinekkuşu çiçeğin üzerinde havada asılı durur gibiydi.

meanings.en: the act of holding someone tightly in your arms with affection
meanings.exampleEn: She gave her mother a warm hug before leaving.
meanings.exampleTr: Gitmeden önce annesine sıcak bir sarılma yaptı.

meanings.en: to a very great degree; enormously
meanings.exampleEn: The new restaurant has become hugely popular in just a month.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni restoran sadece bir ayda son derece popüler oldu.

meanings.en: the basic rights and freedoms that belong to every person
meanings.exampleEn: The organization fights to protect human rights around the world.
meanings.exampleTr: Örgüt, dünya genelinde insan haklarını korumak için mücadele ediyor.

meanings.en: showing kindness and compassion toward people or animals
meanings.exampleEn: They demanded more humane treatment of the prisoners.
meanings.exampleTr: Mahkumlara daha insancıl davranılmasını talep ettiler.

meanings.en: a person who emphasizes human values and reason over religion
meanings.exampleEn: As a humanist, she believed in the power of human kindness.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir hümanist olarak insan iyiliğinin gücüne inanıyordu.

meanings.en: to make something more humane or relatable to people
meanings.exampleEn: The author tried to humanize the villain by showing his past.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazar, kötü adamın geçmişini göstererek onu insanileştirmeye çalıştı.

meanings.en: dishonest or deceptive talk or behavior; nonsense
meanings.exampleEn: He dismissed the politician's promises as pure humbug.
meanings.exampleTr: Politikacının vaatlerini tam bir palavra olarak görmezden geldi.

meanings.en: to make someone feel ashamed or foolish, especially publicly
meanings.exampleEn: He didn't want to humiliate her in front of her colleagues.
meanings.exampleTr: Onu meslektaşlarının önünde küçük düşürmek istemedi.

meanings.en: causing someone to feel ashamed or foolish
meanings.exampleEn: Losing the game by such a wide margin was humiliating for the team.
meanings.exampleTr: Oyunu bu kadar farkla kaybetmek takım için küçük düşürücüydü.

meanings.en: the feeling of being ashamed or foolish, or the act of causing it
meanings.exampleEn: She could not hide her humiliation after the public mistake.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin önünde yaptığı hatadan sonra aşağılanmışlığını gizleyemedi.

meanings.en: the activity of chasing and killing wild animals
meanings.exampleEn: Hunting is strictly controlled to protect endangered species.
meanings.exampleTr: Nesli tükenmekte olan türleri korumak için avcılık sıkı şekilde denetleniyor.

meanings.en: to make someone or something quiet
meanings.exampleEn: She tried to hush the crying baby with a soft lullaby.
meanings.exampleTr: Ağlayan bebeği yumuşak bir ninniyle susturmaya çalıştı.

meanings.en: made by combining two different things
meanings.exampleEn: They bought a hybrid car that uses both petrol and electricity.
meanings.exampleTr: Hem benzin hem de elektrik kullanan melez bir araba aldılar.

meanings.en: the practice of keeping clean to stay healthy
meanings.exampleEn: Good personal hygiene helps prevent the spread of disease.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi kişisel hijyen, hastalıkların yayılmasını önlemeye yardımcı olur.

meanings.en: exaggerated statements not meant to be taken literally
meanings.exampleEn: Saying you're 'starving' when slightly hungry is a common hyperbole.
meanings.exampleTr: Biraz açken 'açlıktan ölüyorum' demek yaygın bir abartmadır.

meanings.en: the punctuation mark (-) used to join words or parts of words
meanings.exampleEn: Remember to put a hyphen between 'well' and 'known' in that phrase.
meanings.exampleTr: O ifadede 'well' ve 'known' arasına bir kısa çizgi koymayı unutma.

meanings.en: a person who sells or delivers ice
meanings.exampleEn: Years ago, the iceman delivered blocks of ice to homes each week.
meanings.exampleTr: Yıllar önce, buzcu her hafta evlere buz kalıpları teslim ederdi.
